title: Cosmic Piano Conjurer
description: A hooded figure in a flowing dark robe sits at a black grand piano, hands raised as swirling ribbons of colorful cosmic energy erupt from the instrument. The energy transforms into musical notes, spirals, and glowing particles against a pitch-black background filled with concentric rings and starry specks.
prompt: A hooded sorcerer in ornate dark robes playing a sleek black grand piano in a void of deep space. From the piano bursts a swirling vortex of colorful ribbons in teal, purple, magenta and gold containing musical notes, glowing spirals, and cosmic particles. Concentric ripple rings emanate from the scene, dark mystical atmosphere, dramatic lighting, surreal fantasy style.
